trace.notes: Normalized URL input https://zbmath.org/932388 as a zbMATH resolver record for document id 932388.

Queried the zbMATH Open API for document 932388. The API returned metadata for Zbl 0859.46002 with title Some open problems in the theory of locally convex spaces, but the record contained no full-text links.

Queried the referenced proceedings record Zbl 0842.00035 via zbMATH API. It confirmed the article appears on pages 147-165 of Linear topological spaces and complex analysis I, but also exposed no readable PDF or HTML artifact.

Failure mode: metadata_only. Bounded exact-work recovery attempted searches for the exact title plus PDF, the exact title alone, and the proceedings title or ISBN. Rejected ResearchGate/profile snippets because no readable full text could be opened; rejected Google Books and citation pages because they were snippet or metadata-only records; rejected EUDML, Cambridge, and other hits because they only cited the source or were different works.

No extraction was performed because no readable exact-work primary source was recovered. The workflow did not use abstracts, citation metadata, search snippets, or related-paper references as technical evidence.
